shellCommands.command: ls; cat package.json; ls src 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; cat AGENTS.md | head -30; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "^## Charts\|gravity-ui/charts" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 30,120p
npm view @gravity-ui/charts peerDependencies version 2>&1 | tail -15; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -n -i -A12 "theme" | head -80
npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>&1 | tr -d '\n ' | head -c 1500; echo; for v in 1.30.0 1.20.0; do echo $v; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -6; done

npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '"1\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tail -5; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '1\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*' | tail -40 | awk 'NR%5==0'); do echo -n "$v: "; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -1; done
npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat get-started.md | head -80; ls guides; grep -rn -i "theme\|dark" --include=*.md . | head -20; grep -n -B3 -A30 "line" examples.md | head -80
cat guides/theming.md | head -60; ls guides/series-types guides/axes; sed -n 1,70p guides/series-types/line.md

sed -n 1,40p guides/colors.md; grep -n "title\|xAxis\|yAxis" guides/axes/index.md | head -20; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat tsconfig.json; grep -n "export.*useTheme\|useThemeType" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat useThemeSettings.d.ts ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls
